obs.title: Adding an overlay to OBS
obs.step1: In OBS, under Sources, press + → Browser and give it a name.
obs.step2: Copy the URL above and paste it into URL. Leave "Local file" unchecked.
obs.step3: Enter the Width and Height shown above and press OK.
obs.reconnect: Leave OBS as it is when you restart KbmOverlay. The overlays reconnect within a few seconds.

relay.intro: Run KbmOverlay on both PCs. On the streaming PC, OBS uses the same localhost URLs as with one PC. This PC:

about.title: About
files.title: Editing the files
files.text: Colors, animations and key layouts can be changed in each overlay's menu. This is only for adding a translation or editing the page files (CSS, HTML) yourself. The button makes a pages folder next to the exe, copies the built-in files into it (files already there are kept) and opens it. Files there are used instead of the built-in ones.
